biotools.summary: PySSA is a Windows GUI application that combines ColabFold and PyMOL to enable protein sequence-to-structure prediction, alignment, and visual analysis. It provides a user-friendly environment for scientific end-users without requiring specialized computer skills or powerful hardware.
